title: New E-Bike Regulations to Take Effect in San Diego
description:
The City of San Diego is launching a public education and outreach campaign on e-bike safety ahead of new regulations for kids. City Councilmember Raul Campillo was joined by the San Diego Police Department (SDPD), the San Diego Unified School District (SDUSD) Police Department, and local Girl Scout Troop 4343 outside Montgomery Middle School to announce the outreach effort.

Recently approved e-bike regulations impose a minimum age of 12 years for Class One and Two e-bikes, essentially making a pedal bike the only bike approved for kids under 12. Class Three e-bikes already require individuals to be 16 years or older to operate under state law.
